title: Ionic liquid microemulsion-mediated heterogels with bicontinuous conductive channels for an ionic flexible sensor
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7844-7853
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09922F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yufan Wang, Yue Wang, Li Qin, Zhuo Zhang, Yang Yu
Ionic liquid emulsion-template is used to fabricate heterogels with bicontinuous structure of interpenetrating hydrophilic and hydrophobic phases. The assembled sensor can detect subtle muscle movements and recognize speech, weight and temperature.
